logline: 어른 없이 배에 오른 소년들이 폭풍에 떠밀려 무인도에 닿는다.
destination: 이름 없는 섬 — 소년들만의 나라가 될 곳
protagonist: 곱슬머리에 낡은 교복 재킷을 입은 열네 살 소년
anchor: a fourteen-year-old boy with curly hair in a worn school jacket
palette: storm grey-green, sail canvas white, jungle green, driftwood fire amber

boys_older.label: 큰 소년들
boys_older.desc: three teenage boys in worn school jackets and rolled trousers, wind-tangled hair, bare feet

boys_small.label: 어린 소년들
boys_small.desc: a huddle of small boys aged eight to ten in oversized coats, soaked hair, clinging together

island_shore.label: 섬 해변
island_shore.desc: a wide unmarked beach backed by dense jungle, driftwood, pale sand, no buildings

beats.visual: boys clinging to rigging on a pitching schooner deck in a storm, no adults aboard
beats.motion: the deck heaves under them, spray bursts over the rail, the sail rips loose

beats.beat: 큰 소년이 키를 두 손으로 붙든다.
beats.visual: a teenage boy gripping a ship's wheel with both hands in driving rain, dark water ahead
beats.motion: the wheel wrenches against his hands, rain drives across the deck, lightning flares

beats.beat: 새벽 안개 속에 배가 모래톱에 얹혀 있다.
beats.visual: a schooner run aground on a pale sandbar at dawn, jungle beyond, mist on the water
beats.motion: surf breaks along the hull, mist lifts off the sand, a torn sail flaps

beats.visual: boys carrying crates and barrels from a stranded ship up a wide empty beach
beats.motion: they haul the crates up the sand away from the surf, gulls scatter, sand sprays

beats.visual: teenage boys seated around a driftwood fire on a beach at dusk, jungle dark behind
beats.motion: the fire snaps and throws sparks upward, their shadows swing across the sand

beats.beat: 소년이 나무에 올라 섬 안쪽을 살핀다.
beats.visual: a boy high in a palm crown scanning inland over dense jungle toward distant hills
beats.motion: he climbs higher up the trunk, fronds thrash, birds burst out below him

beats.beat: 소년들이 젖은 모래의 발자국 앞에 모여 선다.
beats.visual: a group of boys halted around fresh unfamiliar footprints in wet beach sand
beats.motion: they crowd in around the prints, one points ahead, foam slides up the sand

beats.beat: 빈 해변에 꺼져 가는 모닥불만 남는다.
beats.visual: an empty beach at dawn with a dying driftwood fire, scattered crates, calm sea
beats.motion: the last embers pulse and fade, smoke bends along the sand, surf runs up

withheld: 발자국의 주인과, 소년들이 섬을 떠나게 되는 마지막
